summary: UTime Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Shenzhen-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 10, 2026 extraordinary general meeting (the non-US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting). Holders of 26,065,779 Class A ordinary shares, roughly 99.19% of the 26,276,331 outstanding and entitled to vote, established quorum. Four ordinary/special resolutions passed: a massive authorized-share increase, a share subdivision, amended and restated articles, and a contingent reverse-split authority (1:10 to 1:100) triggered only if the share price trades below US$1.00 for five consecutive trading days. No special-situation transaction is present; this is routine charter-housekeeping. Watch reverse-split timing and any future capital-raising given the enlarged authorized capital.
